2pt83vlkk7x7.name: Elevated latency on the Claude API for some users
2pt83vlkk7x7.last_update: We are experiencing slower than normal response times on the Claude API for some customers whose traffic enters through the US Midwest. Users may experience elevated latency and some request timeouts.
